feedback.end: Words like “furthermore” link paragraphs by showing that the next paragraph is about the same topic, even if the specific content is different.

instruction.text: Read the text and select the word that links the second paragraph to the first.

atoms.b:
It is very important to recycle. Recycling plastics and other materials helps to protect the environment and the planet. It is important to protect the planet for future generations.

((Furthermore,)) recycling helps to preserve natural resources. It is important to preserve natural resources in order to protect the planet.

My mum has never run a marathon before. She also doesn’t enjoy running and prefers to go swimming or cycling.

((Nevertheless)), my mum has signed up to run the Newport half-marathon next year. She has already started to train for it.

My sister is saving up for a new house. She has recently got a new job in a law firm.

((Additionally)), she would like to be able to buy a new car. She wants a blue car because blue is her favourite colour.

Douglas loves to eat fresh fruit such as mango, strawberries and melon. He really enjoys eating fruit with yogurt and cereal.

((++On_the_other_hand Additionally)), Maya doesn’t enjoy eating fresh fruit. She much prefers eating fruit from a tin.

Stephanie plays the piano. She often plays the piano at weddings to earn money.

((++In_addition However)), Stephanie also plays the harp. She plays in a string orchestra. The string orchestra practises every Saturday.

Ronda went to the shop last week to buy the ingredients to make a cake. The shop didn’t have most of the ingredients.

((++Nevertheless In_addition)), she tried to make the cake with what she did have.
